notes: Sulawesi is two orders of magnitude larger than timor_demo, so an exact-UC expansion MILP is out of reach on HiGHS at any wall-clock budget a study can afford: raising time_limit (Tier A) is not a real fix. The sanctioned fix is relax_uc=true (Tier B) — the LP relaxation the modeller explicitly allowed, ~0.8 % below the exact MILP cost on the reference dataset. A Tier-A escape (solver=gurobi) is legitimate where a licence exists, hence alternative_fix_tiers=['A'].
